description: T1 item 1 (Design sources). sources: the committed RTL (rtl/ targets: klt refuses paths through the src/protocol_*.v symlinks, whose targets these are), the boot-ROM generator chain, the klt/Yosys request, the LibreLane configuration and the PDK black-box/vendored SRAM models. derived: the two gate-level netlists of record. Their freshness check is the sha256 pin in manifests/evidence/design-sources.txt, verified by scripts/check_evidence_inventories.py --inventory design-sources.txt (a re-synthesis compare is not byte-stable across Yosys versions, layout/toolchain.json 2026-10-12). The .txt keeps the audit prose; firmware/tools/check_firmware.py (CI records job) checks the boot-ROM chain link by link.
